domain.policy: native deterministic greedy on every seat

command_template: OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 nice -n 19 python -m python.benchmark_seat_balance --games 256 --batch-size 32 --seed {seed} --width 19 --height 15 --players 5 --action-limit 2400 --generator-schema-version {schema_version}
pairing: Within each seed window, schema 1 and schema 2 use identical land, capital hexes, neutral objects, rules, agent, and action limit. Schema 2 assigns each generated starting province to player (original_position + seed % players) % players. Each reported game is a complete greedy self-play run; adjudicated truncations are included in wins and listed separately.
interpretation: Across two fresh windows, the fixed link between generator insertion order and player ID produced 122 wins of spread between seats under schema 1. The opt-in seed rotation reduced that descriptive spread to 34 wins and equalized mean initial Voronoi allocations. Seat zero still won 126 of 512 schema-2 games, so turn order and first-round economy remain relevant. A single schema-2 map can still give unequal positions; these observations do not establish calibrated Elo, model strength, or fair rated matchmaking.
decision: Accept schema 2 as a versioned, opt-in domain-randomization and evaluation candidate. Keep schema 1 as default for exact replay and checkpoint compatibility. Do not silently migrate training corpora, model routes, or rated multiplayer; validate those workflows separately before promotion.
